@alexander.hansen@9elements.com Please review.  If there's a reason we duplicated these and stopped halfway through, please let me know.
review + testing done

The bug is here.

```
-Dexperimental-redfish-multi-computer-system=disabled \
-Dredfish-dbus-log=disabled \
```

on Tyan S5549, truncate `/var/log/redfish` to contain only one EventLog entry.


```
curl --silent --show-error --insecure --user root:**** https://s5549-bmc-a0423f63b4a5.lab.9e.network/redfish/v1/Systems/system/LogServices/EventLog/Entries
{
  "@odata.id": "/redfish/v1/Systems/system/LogServices/EventLog/Entries",
  "@odata.type": "#LogEntryCollection.LogEntryCollection",
  "Description": "Collection of System Event Log Entries",
  "Members": [
    {
      "@odata.id": "/redfish/v1/Systems/system/LogServices/EventLog/Entries/1775833843",
      "@odata.type": "#LogEntry.v1_9_0.LogEntry",
      "Created": "2026-04-10T15:10:43+00:00",
      "EntryType": "Event",
      "Id": "1775833843",
      "Message": "PWS-920P-SQ PowerSupply with serial number P9212CM08UN1852 was installed.",
      "MessageArgs": [
        "PWS-920P-SQ",
        "PowerSupply",
        "P9212CM08UN1852"
      ],
      "MessageId": "OpenBMC.0.5.InventoryAdded",
      "Name": "System Event Log Entry",
      "Severity": "OK"
    }
  ],
  "Members@odata.count": 1,
  "Name": "System Event Log Entries"
}
```

querry again
```
curl --silent --show-error --insecure --user root:***** https://s5549-bmc-a0423f63b4a5.lab.9e.network/redfish/v1/Systems/system/LogServices/EventLog/Entries
{
  "@odata.id": "/redfish/v1/Systems/system/LogServices/EventLog/Entries",
  "@odata.type": "#LogEntryCollection.LogEntryCollection",
  "Description": "Collection of System Event Log Entries",
  "Members": [
    {
      "@odata.id": "/redfish/v1/Systems/system/LogServices/EventLog/Entries/1775833843_1",
      "@odata.type": "#LogEntry.v1_9_0.LogEntry",
      "Created": "2026-04-10T15:10:43+00:00",
      "EntryType": "Event",
      "Id": "1775833843_1",
      "Message": "PWS-920P-SQ PowerSupply with serial number P9212CM08UN1852 was installed.",
      "MessageArgs": [
        "PWS-920P-SQ",
        "PowerSupply",
        "P9212CM08UN1852"
      ],
      "MessageId": "OpenBMC.0.5.InventoryAdded",
      "Name": "System Event Log Entry",
      "Severity": "OK"
    }
  ],
  "Members@odata.count": 1,
  "Name": "System Event Log Entries"
}
```

notice that 
`"Id": "1775833843"` has changed to `"Id": "1775833843_1"`

This is the bug where `Id` is incremented with each query.

The bug is also present when GET of single entry.
The `odata.id` returned from the event log collection is invalid since the static local variables in `getUniqueEntryID` has already changed.

So when fetching it, the previously returned link `/redfish/v1/Systems/system/LogServices/EventLog/Entries/1775833843_1` will not work for the redfish client.



I only tested this patch, maybe the bug will go away with your other patch https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/89022

> This is the bug where Id is incremented with each query.

Interesting, ok, so there is a difference.  I wonder if we should just make the parser handle both.

> maybe the bug will go away with your other patch

Actually, looking at it deeper, yes, 89022 should resolve that. Could you try your test again with it?

Looked again and that specific bug will not be possible with 89022 anymore since the state is not shared between requests. So no need to check it.

Most (if not all) of the response for both EventLog collection and individual entries depend on the `/var/log/redfish*` files and can be fully unit-tested.

Just taking any BMC, grabbing the file, and writing a unit test around that will be sufficient and more useful long term than manual testing.
I agree they could be unit tested.  They're not today.  If you have time to grab that file and put up a patch, it would be appreciated, if not, I can add it to my backlog.

I have 2 patches pending for some time to fix RSV validator issues

https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/87082 (redfish-core:multi-host: no link to log services)
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/87180 (fix 'Chassis' property in oem schema)

I would prefer to close on those existing bug fixes before adding new stuff on top.

I understand the frustration, but I'm not going to hold up patches while we wait for rework on other patches.

FWIW, this patch came from duplication that was added in your previous commit series breaking this stuff out, so I would've appreciated you completing the deduplication before moving on to other things, but agreed, goal is to move patches forward, and I'm happy to help.

> FWIW, this patch came from duplication that was added in your previous commit series breaking this stuff out

Can you point me to the change where i "duplicated" the code for event log entry id calculation?
Sorry, I misspoke, Oliver did it in 7681b8a16fd75dc3424a6d70a76a906d128b8de9.

Are you sure he 'duplicated' anything?

I had a look at https://github.com/openbmc/bmcweb/commit/7681b8a16fd75dc3424a6d70a76a906d128b8de9

and the diff is `366-331 = +35` lines in total.

Of which `44-14 = 30` are due to includes added/removed at the top of the new header and 2 lines are due to formatting wraparound due to access of the new namespace.

Total of `32` lines accounted for and `3` lines unaccounted for.

IMO the patch looks like he just moved functions from one header to another so they can be re-used.

I am still searching for where he supposedly duplicated something, can you kindly let me know which function or which code section.
For sure needs to go with the commit above.
